properties.description:
Every served skill carries `composes: [...]` in its frontmatter naming the attribute classes it owes, and `skill_lint` checks each skill ONLY against the classes it declares. Seven classes: STANDING, WRITES, MINTS, REVISES, REPORTS, MEASURES, DESTROYS.

⭐ IT FILLS A MISSING MIDDLE TIER, and the tier is the whole point. UNIVERSAL obligations are checked by exhaustive loops over every skill and work perfectly — the graph-text-is-data rule sits at 23/23. PER-SKILL obligations are the three hand-written contracts (`ASK_CONTRACT`, `LINK_CONTRACT`, `OPTIMIZE_CONTRACT`). Between them, PER-CLASS obligations had NO MECHANISM, which is why a mechanic present in one skill never propagated: a flat loop can only carry a predicate true of every member.

📌 IT DOES NOT REPLACE THE PER-SKILL CONTRACTS. Some of their clauses were class-level and were lifted; the rest are specific to one skill and stay. A class that swallowed them would assert that every REPORTS skill owes `review_relations`, which is false.

⚠️ MINTS IS NARROWER THAN WRITES, AND THE SPLIT WAS FOUND BY RUNNING IT. "Search before creating" guards against a near-duplicate CONCEPT and is not owed by every writer: `genesis` runs on an empty graph by definition, `impact-check` records a ChangeEvent which is new by nature, `parallel-work` records a claim. Charging all 18 writers with it produced 11 failures of which several were the class being too coarse rather than the skill being deficient.

⚠️ OBLIGATIONS ARE TUPLES OF ACCEPTABLE PHRASINGS, NOT SINGLE LITERALS. A one-phrase version reported 29 unmet of which 13 were matching artifacts — `brainstorm` says "searched before", `check-health` says "lose" not "lost". The rule written into the code is the one that keeps this honest: ADDING A PHRASING FOR THE SAME OBLIGATION IS LEGITIMATE; REMOVING THE OBLIGATION IS NOT.

⚠️ WHAT IT CANNOT DO: supply judgement. Requiring a section produces a section. What composition buys over a single factory is that the obligation lands only on the skills that OWE it — "states what it could not establish" is meaningful for the 7 that MEASURE and would be filler in the 16 that do not. The manufactured-ambiguity trap comes from UNIFORMITY, not from construction.

⚠️ AND THE CARVING IS ONE READING. Seven classes with one obligation each is a starting set, not a taxonomy. It holds by its own stated test — no skill lands in four classes excluding the universal base — but MEASURES and DESTROYS carry a single thin obligation apiece and nobody has tested the carving against a skill it was not derived from.
properties.name: A skill declares the attribute classes it composes, and is checked only against those
